input.question: Which electoral district is Larré associated with?

documents.text:
Larré

Larré is a commune in the Orne department in the Normandy region in northwestern France. Electoral District

Larré is associated with the electoral district of Canton of La Région Limouxine, a canton of France. This association was established in 2015, following a series of studies and reforms aimed at reorganizing the electoral districts of France. Studies and Reforms

In 2012, the French National Assembly launched a comprehensive study on the electoral districts of France, with the goal of improving the representation of rural communes like Larré. The study, led by the French Ministry of the Interior, concluded that the existing electoral districts were inefficient and did not accurately reflect the demographic changes in rural areas. In response to the study's findings, the French government introduced a series of reforms aimed at reorganizing the electoral districts. The reforms, which were implemented in 2015, resulted in the creation of new cantons, including the Canton of La Région Limouxine. The Canton of La Région Limouxine was established by decree on February 17, 2015, and comprises 15 communes, including Larré. The canton is part of the Orne department and is represented by two councilors in the General Council of Orne. References

* "Rapport sur la réforme des cantons" (Report on the Reform of Cantons), French Ministry of the Interior, 2012. * "Décret n° 2015-172 du 17 février 2015 portant sur la création des cantons du département de l'Orne" (Decree No. 2015-172 of February 17, 2015, on the Creation of Cantons in the Orne Department), Journal Officiel de la République Française, 2015. * "La Région Limouxine: un nouveau canton pour l'Orne" (La Région Limouxine: A New Canton for Orne), Le Courrier de l'Orne, March 2015.
